name: Paludal-Spandrel
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait frozen methane lakes, and everything the light never reaches.

Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
Whoever abandoned derelict space station in orbit did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
